name: com.restframe.shaders
description: Rest-frame-anchored 4D-noise cross-fade shaders for the Universal Render Pipeline. A lit mesh shader (VR/RestFrame), a terrain shader (VR/TerrainRestFrame) and a skybox shader (Skybox/RestFrame) cross-fade between two complete surfaces using one shared, rest-frame-anchored noise field that can be driven by an anchor object.

samples.description: Example scene with materials, a motion script and demo assets.
